		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_savannah_arame_6 } omni_gse_item_gen_savannah_arame_6 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_savannah_arame_7 } omni_gse_item_gen_savannah_arame_7 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_savannah_arame_8 } omni_gse_item_gen_savannah_arame_8 = yes }

		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_savannah_arame_14 } omni_gse_item_gen_savannah_arame_14 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_savannah_arame_15 } omni_gse_item_gen_savannah_arame_15 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_savannah_arame_16 } omni_gse_item_gen_savannah_arame_16 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_savannah_arame_17 } omni_gse_item_gen_savannah_arame_17 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_savannah_arame_18 } omni_gse_item_gen_savannah_arame_18 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_savannah_arame_19 } omni_gse_item_gen_savannah_arame_19 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_savannah_arame_20 } omni_gse_item_gen_savannah_arame_20 = yes }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = omni_gen_cult_southern_arame target = var:$SLOTVAR$ } }
		if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_1 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_1 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_2 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_2 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_3 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_3 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_4 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_4 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_5 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_5 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_6 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_6 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_7 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_7 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_8 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_8 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_9 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_9 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_10 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_10 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_11 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_11 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_12 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_12 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_13 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_13 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_14 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_14 = yes }

		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_16 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_16 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_17 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_17 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_18 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_18 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_19 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_19 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_southern_arame_20 } omni_gse_item_gen_southern_arame_20 = yes }

	else_if = { limit = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = omni_gen_cult_sporling target = var:$SLOTVAR$ } }
		if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_sporling_1 } omni_gse_item_gen_sporling_1 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_sporling_2 } omni_gse_item_gen_sporling_2 = yes }

		else_if = { limit = { var:$SLOTVAR$ = flag:item_gen_sporling_20 } omni_gse_item_gen_sporling_20 = yes }
